description: This Java interface defines configuration settings related to metrics, including methods for querying system metrics enablement, Prometheus enablement, hostname, and port. It also contains an inner enum for known configuration values with associated default settings.

classes.name: MetricsConfig
classes.description: Interface providing methods to access metrics configuration settings.

classes.name: MetricsConfig.MetricsConfigValue
classes.description: Enum representing known configuration keys with default values for metrics settings.

methods.name: isSystemMetricsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether system metrics are enabled.

methods.name: isPrometheusEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether Prometheus metrics are enabled.

methods.name: getPrometheusHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname for the Prometheus HTTP server.

methods.name: getPrometheusPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the Prometheus HTTP server.
